reference_counts.meaning: Read-only query reference counts; not collected papers or hard-coded success criteria

topics.name: 영양유전체 전반
topics.query: (Nutrigenomics[MeSH Terms] OR nutrigenom*[Title/Abstract] OR nutrigenet*[Title/Abstract] OR ((Diet[MeSH Terms] OR Food[MeSH Terms] OR Nutrients[MeSH Terms] OR dietary[Title/Abstract] OR nutrition*[Title/Abstract]) AND (Gene Expression Regulation[MeSH Terms] OR Epigenomics[MeSH Terms] OR DNA Methylation[MeSH Terms] OR transcriptom*[Title/Abstract] OR metabolom*[Title/Abstract] OR proteom*[Title/Abstract] OR epigen*[Title/Abstract] OR genom*[Title/Abstract])))

topics.name: 영양 중재 임상·메타분석
topics.query: (Diet[MeSH Terms] OR Nutrients[MeSH Terms] OR dietary[Title/Abstract] OR nutrition*[Title/Abstract]) AND (Randomized Controlled Trial[Publication Type] OR Meta-Analysis[Publication Type]) AND (Cardiovascular Diseases[MeSH Terms] OR Diabetes Mellitus[MeSH Terms] OR Obesity[MeSH Terms] OR Fatty Liver[MeSH Terms] OR Blood Pressure[MeSH Terms])

topics.name: 고혈압·후성유전
topics.query: (hypertension[MeSH Terms] OR blood pressure[Title/Abstract]) AND (DNA methylation[Title/Abstract] OR epigenetic[Title/Abstract] OR nutrigenomics[Title/Abstract] OR nutritional genomics[Title/Abstract])

topics.name: DASH
topics.query: (Dietary Approaches to Stop Hypertension[Title/Abstract] OR DASH diet[Title/Abstract]) AND (hypertension[MeSH Terms] OR blood pressure[Title/Abstract])

topics.name: 오메가3
topics.query: (Fatty Acids, Omega-3[MeSH Terms] OR omega-3[Title/Abstract] OR eicosapentaenoic acid[Title/Abstract] OR docosahexaenoic acid[Title/Abstract]) AND (hypertension[MeSH Terms] OR blood pressure[Title/Abstract])

topics.name: 비타민D
topics.query: (Vitamin D[MeSH Terms] OR cholecalciferol[Title/Abstract] OR ergocalciferol[Title/Abstract] OR calcitriol[Title/Abstract]) AND (hypertension[MeSH Terms] OR blood pressure[Title/Abstract])

topics.name: 카페인
topics.query: (Caffeine[MeSH Terms] OR caffeine[Title/Abstract]) AND (hypertension[MeSH Terms] OR blood pressure[Title/Abstract])

topics.name: 코코아·플라바놀
topics.query: (cocoa[Title/Abstract] OR cacao[Title/Abstract] OR flavanol*[Title/Abstract]) AND (hypertension[MeSH Terms] OR blood pressure[Title/Abstract])
